questions.text: The North Pole _____ a latitude of 90 degrees north.
questions.explanation: Subject ada, butuh satu verb sejati: 'has'. 'it has' menambah subject, 'which is having' membuka klausa baru tanpa perlu, dan 'have' bermakna memiliki tidak lazim dipakai dengan -ing.
hints: Kalimat butuh apa?
Subject 'The North Pole' sudah ada. Pilih bentuk paling sederhana yang membawa tense.
D 'has'. A menambah subject, C membuka klausa tambahan.

xray.marked: S{The North Pole} V{has} a latitude P{of 90 degrees} north.

questions.text: The city of Beverly Hills is surrounded on _____ the city of Los Angeles.
questions.explanation: 'is surrounded' passive, butuh pelaku dengan 'by'. 'on all sides by' frasa depan yang pas. Pilihan lain menambah verb atau subject.
hints: Verb sejati sudah ada. Apa yang kurang?
'is surrounded' passive. Pelaku passive biasanya ditandai kata apa?
D 'all sides by'. A, B, C menambah subject atau verb yang tidak diperlukan.

xray.marked: S{The city of Beverly Hills} V{is surrounded} P{on all sides} P{by the city of Los Angeles}.

questions.text: _____ greyhound, can achieve speeds up to thirty-six miles per hour.
questions.explanation: Setelah 'greyhound' ada koma, jadi 'the greyhound' appositive. Subject 'the fastest dog' diikuti appositive 'the greyhound'.
hints: Perhatikan koma setelah 'greyhound'. Bagian itu fungsinya apa?
Kalau 'greyhound' di antara koma, ia appositive. Siapa subjectnya?
D. 'The fastest dog, the greyhound,' subject + appositive.

xray.marked: S{The fastest dog}, M{the greyhound}, V{can achieve} speeds P{up to thirty-six miles per hour}.

questions.text: Marmots spend their time foraging among meadow plants and flowers or _____ on rocky cliffs.
questions.explanation: 'or' menghubungkan dua bentuk yang sejajar: 'foraging ...' dan 'sunning ...'. Keduanya -ing.
hints: Kata 'or' menyambung apa dengan apa?
Bentuk sebelum 'or' adalah 'foraging'. Cari yang sejajar.
B 'sunning'. 'gets sun' menambah verb dengan tense, 'the sun' dan 'sunny' tidak sejajar.

xray.marked: S{Marmots} V{spend} their time M{foraging among meadow plants and flowers} or M{sunning on rocky cliffs}.

questions.text: The greenhouse effect occurs _____ heat radiated from the Sun.

options.text: when does the Earth's atmosphere trap

questions.explanation: Dua klausa butuh connector. 'when' menyambung, dan setelah connector urutan subject-verb biasa (bukan inversi): 'the Earth's atmosphere traps'.
hints: Sudah ada klausa 'The greenhouse effect occurs'. Yang kosong adalah klausa kedua?
Klausa kedua butuh connector, dan urutannya subject lalu verb.
C. A dan B memakai inversi 'does' yang hanya untuk pertanyaan langsung; D tanpa connector.

xray.marked: S{The greenhouse effect} V{occurs} C{when} S{the Earth's atmosphere} V{traps} heat M{radiated from the Sun}.

questions.text: The Rose Bowl, _____ place on New Year's Day, is the oldest postseason collegiate football game in the United States.
questions.explanation: Bagian di antara koma menerangkan 'The Rose Bowl' dan punya verb sendiri, jadi butuh connector yang juga jadi subject: 'which takes'.
hints: Ada dua verb di kalimat ini ('...place' dan 'is'). Apa yang menghubungkannya?
Klausa tambahan yang menerangkan benda butuh adjective clause connector.
C 'which takes'. 'it takes' dan 'took' membuat dua klausa tanpa connector.

xray.marked: S{The Rose Bowl}, R{which} V{takes} place P{on New Year's Day}, V{is} the oldest postseason collegiate football game P{in the United States}.

questions.text: Experiments _____ represent a giant step into the medicine of the future.
questions.explanation: Verb sejati 'represent' sudah ada. 'using gene therapy' penerang untuk 'experiments'. B, C, D menambah verb kedua tanpa connector.
hints: Cari verb sejati yang sudah ada di kalimat.
Kalau 'represent' sudah verb, bagian yang kosong tidak boleh membawa verb sejati lagi.
A 'using gene therapy' penerang (-ing tanpa be).

xray.marked: S{Experiments} M{using gene therapy} V{represent} a giant step P{into the medicine of the future}.

questions.text: _____ off the Hawaiian coastline are living, others are dead.

options.text: While some types of coral reefs
There are many types of coral reefs

questions.explanation: Ada dua klausa ('... are living' dan 'others are dead') dengan koma di tengah. Klausa pertama butuh connector: 'While'.
hints: Hitung klausa: ada 'are living' dan 'are dead'. Cukup connector-nya?
Dua klausa dipisah koma tanpa connector tidak sah.
A 'While some types of coral reefs'. B, C, D tidak punya connector.

xray.marked: C{While} S{some types} P{of coral reefs} P{off the Hawaiian coastline} V{are} living, S{others} V{are} dead.

questions.text: Nimbostratus clouds are thick, dark gray clouds _____ forebode rain.
questions.explanation: 'forebode' perlu subject. 'which' sekaligus connector dan subject (menggantikan 'clouds'). 'which they' menambah subject kedua.
hints: 'forebode' butuh subject. Siapa subjectnya?
Connector yang bisa sekaligus jadi subject untuk benda: who, which, that.
B 'which'. A 'what' tidak dipakai sebagai adjective clause; C dan D menambah subject kedua.

xray.marked: S{Nimbostratus clouds} V{are} thick, dark gray clouds R{which} V{forebode} rain.

questions.text: Some economists now suggest that home equity loans are merely a new trap to push consumers beyond _____.
questions.explanation: Setelah 'beyond' butuh noun clause. 'what is affordable' lengkap: 'what' connector dan subject, 'is' verb. 'they can afford' kekurangan connector/objek.
hints: Setelah 'beyond' butuh benda atau klausa benda?
Noun clause butuh connector (what, that, whether...). Mana yang punya?
C. 'what is affordable' noun clause lengkap.

xray.marked: S{Some economists} now V{suggest} C{that} S{home equity loans} V{are} merely a new trap M{to push consumers beyond} R{what} V{is} affordable.

questions.text: People who reverse the letters of words _____ to read suffer from dyslexia.
questions.explanation: 'suffer' sudah verb utama dan 'who reverse' verb relatif. Bagian kosong hanya boleh penerang: 'when trying' (bentuk ringkas dari when they try).
hints: Hitung verb sejati yang sudah ada.
'reverse' dan 'suffer' sudah dua verb. Yang kosong tidak boleh membawa verb sejati baru.
A 'when trying'. B dan D membawa verb sejati ('tried', 'tries') dan subject baru.

xray.marked: S{People} R{who} V{reverse} the letters P{of words} M{when trying to read} V{suffer} P{from dyslexia}.

questions.text: Featured at the Henry Ford Museum _____ of antique cars dating from 1865.
questions.explanation: Frasa tempat di depan kalimat memicu inversi: verb dulu, subject sesudahnya ('is an exhibit'). Subject asli: 'an exhibit'.
hints: 'Featured at the Henry Ford Museum' itu penerang. Di mana subject dan verbnya?
Frasa tempat di awal sering diikuti inversi.
A 'is an exhibit'. Subject 'an exhibit' muncul setelah verb.

xray.marked: M{Featured at the Henry Ford Museum} V{is} S{an exhibit} P{of antique cars} M{dating from 1865}.

questions.text: Rubber _____ from vulcanized silicones with a high molecular weight is difficult to distinguish from natural rubber.
questions.explanation: Verb sejati 'is' sudah ada. Bagian kosong harus penerang: 'produced' (-ed tanpa be/have, bermakna pasif).
hints: Verb sejati mana yang sudah ada?
Karena 'is' sudah ada, yang kosong harus penerang. Rubber 'dihasilkan' atau 'menghasilkan'?
D 'produced'. 'is produced' menambah verb, 'that produces' maknanya terbalik.

xray.marked: S{Rubber} M{produced from vulcanized silicones with a high molecular weight} V{is} difficult M{to distinguish from natural rubber}.

questions.text: _____ appears considerably larger at the horizon than it does overhead is merely an optical illusion.
questions.explanation: Seluruh bagian sampai 'overhead' adalah subject dari 'is'. Subject berupa klausa, jadi butuh noun clause connector: 'That the Moon appears ...'.
hints: Verb utama kalimat adalah 'is'. Apa subjectnya?
Subject-nya panjang dan punya verb sendiri ('appears'). Bentuk apa yang bisa jadi subject?
B 'That the Moon'. 'When' membuat klausa keterangan, bukan subject.

xray.marked: S{That the Moon appears considerably larger at the horizon than it does overhead} V{is} merely an optical illusion.

questions.text: According to the World Health Organization, _____ any of the six most dangerous diseases to break out, it could be cause for quarantine.
questions.explanation: Pengandaian tanpa 'if' memakai inversi: 'were any of ... to break out' sama dengan 'if any of ... were to break out'.
hints: Kata 'if' tidak ada, tapi ada kondisi. Bentuk apa yang menggantikannya?
Inversi kondisional memakai were / had / should di depan subject.
A 'were'. Urutannya verb (were) lalu subject (any of the six ...).

xray.marked: P{According to the World Health Organization}, V{were} S{any of the six most dangerous diseases} M{to break out}, S{it} V{could be} cause P{for quarantine}.
xray.note: Inversi kondisional menggantikan 'if', jadi connector tersirat.
